main_text.l: SECT. VII.
Cafus Quartus refpicit poft-factum.
Nam ut antequam juretur, & in ipfo ju-
randi actu, oportet effe propofitum ad-
implendi promiffum eo fenfu quo propo-
fitum eft, fine aliqua æquivocatione aut
mentali refervatione : ita poftquam
juratum eft adfit oportet ftudium & cona-
tus, ut idoneo tempore fideliter idipfum
& eodem fenfu quo juratum eft adim-
pleatur fine aliqua evafione aut effugio.
Atque ut unum perjurii genus eft, inter-
jurandum detorquere verba in alium
fenfum, quàm concipiunt audientes :
fic alterum perjurii genus eft, ubi rectè
juraveris, non fincerè agere, fed novo
aliquo excogitato commento juramenti
vim (salvis tamen verbis) declinare
& eludere. {a}Verbis jurisjurandi per varias
entia inerat, inquit de quibusdam Tacitus.
Lepidum recitat ex Herodoto {b}Sto-
bæus de Archetimo quodam, qui apud
Cydiam amicum nummos aliquot aureos
depofuerat. Poft aliquod tempus Ar-
chetimo depofitum repetenti, Cydias
præ auri cupidine acceptum negat. Res

page.notes: The right edge of the text is cut off by the scan edge; the final letters of several lines (e.g. "juramenti", "declinare &", "Res") were read from the visible stubs and the sense of the line. Reference marks: "a" before "Verbis" and "b" before "Stobæus" in the text. The marginal mark for the Stobæus note is read as "b" (it looks like "h" in the scan, but the text carries "b"). The margin note beside "Cafus" is printed in italic.
